summary.goal: Group plans in 'All Plans' section by scope for easier navigation of large plan sets.
summary.context: Plans have scopes (repos, services, domains) in their data model. Grouping by scope helps users find related plans. This is orthogonal to attention-based sections - it organizes the 'everything else' view.

acceptance_criteria.description: All Plans section can toggle between flat list and grouped-by-scope view
Scope groups are collapsible with plan count badges
Plans with multiple scopes appear under each relevant scope
Plans with no scope appear under 'Uncategorized' group
Search/filter works within grouped view
View preference (flat vs grouped) persists in localStorage

steps.title: Create groupPlansByScope utility function
steps.description:
Create a utility function in src/utils/scopeGrouping.ts that groups PlanSummary[] by scope.

Input: PlanSummary[] (from API response)
Output: Map<string, PlanSummary[]> where key is scope name

Logic:
- Iterate plans, for each plan check plan.scopes array
- If scopes is undefined/empty, add to 'Uncategorized' group
- If scopes has values, add plan to EACH scope group (multi-scope plans appear in multiple groups)
- Sort groups alphabetically, with 'Uncategorized' last

Export types:
- type ScopeGroupMap = Map<string, PlanSummary[]>
- function groupPlansByScope(plans: PlanSummary[]): ScopeGroupMap

acceptance_criteria.description: groupPlansByScope(plans) returns Map<string, PlanSummary[]>
Plan with scopes=['api', 'frontend'] appears in both 'api' and 'frontend' groups
Plan with scopes=undefined or scopes=[] goes to 'Uncategorized'
Groups sorted alphabetically, 'Uncategorized' last
Unit test covers all edge cases (empty array, no scopes, multi-scope)

- Inactive button: bg-bg-secondary text-text-secondary hover:text-text-primary hover:bg-bg-hover

Icons (inline SVG, 14x14, stroke-based):
- list: horizontal lines (reuse from ViewModeToggle)

acceptance_criteria.description: Renders two buttons: 'List' and 'Grouped' with distinct icons
Active state matches ViewModeToggle styling (bg-accent-cyan text-bg-deep)
Calls onChange with new mode when clicked
Icons are inline SVG, 14x14, stroke-based per design_system.icons

steps.title: Create ScopeGroup collapsible component
steps.description:
Create a collapsible group component for displaying plans under a scope. Located at src/components/ScopeGroup.tsx.

Props interface:

    scopeName: string            // 'api-service' or 'Uncategorized'

Layout:
- Header bar with:
  - Chevron icon (rotates 90deg when expanded, use ChevronIcon from icons/)
  - Scope name (font-medium text-text-primary)
  - Plan count badge (px-2 py-0.5 text-xs bg-bg-elevated text-text-secondary rounded)

Plan cards:

acceptance_criteria.description: Header shows scope name and plan count in badge
ChevronIcon rotates on expand/collapse (right -> down)
Body animates open/close smoothly (CSS transition)
Plan cards match existing PlansListPage card styling
Empty state shows 'No plans' message if plans.length === 0

steps.title: Create usePlansViewMode hook for persistence
steps.description:
Create a custom hook to persist the user's preferred view mode (list vs grouped) to localStorage. Located at src/hooks/usePlansViewMode.ts.

Interface:
  function usePlansViewMode(): {
    viewMode: PlansViewMode
    setViewMode: (mode: PlansViewMode) => void
  }

Implementation:
- localStorage key: 'planner-plans-view-mode'
- Default: 'list' (flat list)
- On mount: read from localStorage, validate, set state
- On setViewMode: update state AND localStorage
- Handle invalid/missing localStorage values gracefully (fall back to default)

acceptance_criteria.description: Returns current viewMode ('list' or 'grouped')
setViewMode updates state and writes to localStorage
Persists across page reloads
Falls back to 'list' if localStorage is corrupted/empty

steps.title: Create useScopeGroupExpansion hook for collapse state
steps.description:
Create a hook to manage which scope groups are expanded/collapsed, persisting to localStorage. Located at src/hooks/useScopeGroupExpansion.ts.

Interface:
  function useScopeGroupExpansion(): {
    isExpanded: (scopeName: string) => boolean
    toggleExpansion: (scopeName: string) => void
    expandAll: () => void
    collapseAll: () => void
  }

Implementation:
- Store as Set<string> of collapsed scope names (expanded by default)
- localStorage key: 'planner-collapsed-scopes'
- Serialize as JSON array: ['api-service', 'frontend']
- Default: all expanded (empty set)
- Toggle: add to set if expanded, remove if collapsed

acceptance_criteria.description: isExpanded(scopeName) returns true/false correctly
toggleExpansion persists change to localStorage
expandAll/collapseAll work and persist
Default state is all expanded
Collapse state persists across page reloads

steps.title: Integrate grouped view into PlansListPage
steps.description:
Update PlansListPage.tsx to support both flat list and grouped-by-scope views.

Changes to PlansListPage:
1. Add imports: PlansViewModeToggle, ScopeGroup, usePlansViewMode, useScopeGroupExpansion, groupPlansByScope
2. Call usePlansViewMode() and useScopeGroupExpansion() hooks
3. Add PlansViewModeToggle in header, next to existing filter tabs
4. Compute scopeGroups using useMemo when viewMode === 'grouped'
5. Conditionally render:
   - viewMode === 'list': existing <ul> with plan cards
   - viewMode === 'grouped': ScopeGroup components per scope
6. Apply status filter BEFORE grouping (filter plans first, then group)

Filtering logic:
- Current filter (draft/approved/published/all) applies to plans array
- Filtered plans are then grouped by scope
- Empty groups (after filtering) should be hidden

Layout adjustment:
- Add view toggle button to header row, right of filter tabs
- Responsive: on mobile, toggle could stack below filters

acceptance_criteria.description: PlansViewModeToggle appears in header, switches between list/grouped views
Grouped view shows ScopeGroup for each scope with plans
Status filter (draft/approved/published) works in grouped view
Empty scope groups (after filtering) are not displayed
View mode persists when navigating away and back
Scope collapse states persist independently of view mode

steps.title: Add search functionality to grouped view
steps.description:
Add a search input to PlansListPage that filters plans by goal text, working in both list and grouped views.

Changes:
1. Add search state: const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('')
2. Add search input in header (after filter tabs, before view toggle)
3. Filter plans by: plan.goal.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())
4. Apply search filter BEFORE status filter AND grouping

Search input styling (from design_system.patterns.forms):
- bg-bg-secondary border-border-default rounded-md
- focus:border-accent-cyan focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-cyan/50
- Placeholder: 'Search plans...'
- Clear button (X) when query is non-empty

Edge cases:
- Empty search: show all plans (subject to status filter)
- No results: show 'No plans match your search' message
- Grouped view with search: hide empty groups after search filtering

acceptance_criteria.description: Search input appears in header between filters and view toggle
Search filters plans by goal text (case-insensitive)
Search works in both list and grouped views
Clear button appears when search has text
No results state shows appropriate message
Empty groups after search are hidden in grouped view

steps.title: Extract PlanCard component
steps.description:
Extract the plan card markup from PlansListPage into a reusable PlanCard component. Located at src/components/PlanCard.tsx.

This step ensures consistent plan card rendering between flat list and grouped views.

Props interface:
  interface PlanCardProps {
    plan: PlanSummary
  }

Move from PlansListPage:
- The <Link> with card styling
- Status badge with color logic (getStatusColor, getStatusBadgeClasses)
- Card accent classes (getCardAccentClasses)
- Goal, scopes, version, date display
- ChevronIcon on hover

The component should be self-contained with its own styling helper functions or accept variant props if needed.

acceptance_criteria.description: PlanCard renders identical output to current inline card markup
PlanCard is exported from components/index.ts
PlansListPage uses PlanCard instead of inline markup
ScopeGroup uses PlanCard for rendering plans

cases.description: Groups plans by their scope values into Map<string, PlanSummary[]>
Multi-scope plan appears in both 'api' and 'frontend' groups when scopes=['api','frontend']
Plan with scopes=undefined goes to 'Uncategorized' group
Plan with scopes=[] (empty array) goes to 'Uncategorized' group
Empty plans array returns empty Map
Groups are sorted alphabetically with 'Uncategorized' always last
Hook returns 'list' by default when localStorage is empty
setViewMode('grouped') persists to localStorage and updates state
Invalid localStorage value (e.g., 'invalid') falls back to 'list'
All scopes expanded by default (isExpanded returns true for any scope)
toggleExpansion collapses an expanded scope (stores in collapsed set)
Corrupted localStorage (non-array) resets to all expanded

data_requirements: Mock PlanSummary objects with various scope configurations: single scope, multi-scope, no scope, empty array
localStorage mock for hook tests (jest.spyOn or testing-library/react-hooks)

tester.strategy: Focus on the pure logic (grouping utility) with unit tests. UI interactions are straightforward toggles/clicks covered by acceptance criteria during implementation. Skip E2E for this non-critical feature.
tester.notes: The groupPlansByScope utility is pure logic - ideal for unit tests. The hooks are simple state+localStorage wrappers. Components (PlansViewModeToggle, ScopeGroup, PlanCard) are presentational with minimal logic - visual correctness verified during implementation, not automated tests.
